title: Simple Hats - Lowered Drop Rate
description: Lowers the drop rate of Simple hats from 100% to 10%.
body:
### _Velox_ presents: Simple Hats - Lowered Rates (_**10%**_) ### 

This datapack lowers the default drop rate of Simple Hats from always dropping from entities or looting from chests to a rate of 10%. Making the hats feel rarer and valuable. 

Originally made for the [Velox Modpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/velox-resurrected).

Hope you enjoy the new rates, and thank you, everyone, for your support/feedback. 

Like what you see? See more goodness in our main modpack, [Velox Resurrected](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/velox-resurrected).
